nodes.description: Private owner address of YOLT contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole privileged role.
Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf tracking token balances.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance of spenders.
Public totalSupply of the YOLT token, set in constructor.
Public token name string set in constructor.
Public token symbol string set in constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18.
Internal constant UNI router address (0x7a250d...) used for pre-approved allowance.
payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender and initial allowance to the router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom with ensure modifier; performs raw unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only function distributing _value to an array of recipients, computing total = _value * _tos.length.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address derivation using keccak256 of tokens and init code hash.
Modifier on transferFrom requiring _from or _to to be the owner or _from to be the derived UNI pair.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership, transfers and authorization checks.
a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary user-supplied address, executing untrusted code in this contract's context.
uint total = _value * _tos.length computed with raw multiplication, vulnerable to integer overflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath, relying only on a preceding require for underflow safety.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed with raw unchecked arithmetic.

Constructor parameter _supply.

Modifier parameter _to of ensure.
Local address UNI in ensure computed by pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)).

Local pair address derived from the init code hash in pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor, establishing the privileged role.
msg.sender is used as the implicit sender when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is read as the spender and as _from in transferFrom allowance checks.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
require(msg.sender == owner) in delegate gates the privileged delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) in batchSend gates batch distribution.
Only the msg.sender matching owner can reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier on entry.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall operation after the owner check.
batchSend computes total by raw multiplication of _value and _tos.length, exposing overflow.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] inside the distribution loop.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].

owner state variable is read for the authorization check in batchSend.

_value is a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.

Local UNI pair address computed and used inside the ensure modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only consumed by transfer when forwarding to transferFrom.
_value is only consumed by transfer when forwarding to transferFrom.
_from is used solely inside transferFrom's allowance and balance logic.
_to is used solely as the credited recipient inside transferFrom.
_value is used solely as the moved amount inside transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance key in approve.
_value is only stored as the allowance amount in approve.
a is the attacker-supplied delegatecall target and belongs to that unsafe operation.
b is the raw calldata supplied directly to the delegatecall.
_tos.length is a factor of the unchecked multiplication, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
_value is the other factor of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
factory is only an input to the pair derivation computation in pairFor.
tokenA is only an input to the pair derivation computation in pairFor.
tokenB is only an input to the pair derivation computation in pairFor.
_name is only stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
_symbol is only stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_supply only seeds totalSupply and the deployer balance in the constructor.
_from is only read by the ensure modifier authorization require.
_to is only read by the ensure modifier authorization require.
The derived pair address exists only within the ensure modifier's check.
total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication and is later subtracted from balanceOf.
i is only the loop index of the batchSend distribution loop.
The loop-local recipient only exists within the batchSend loop.
token0 is a transient ordering local used only for the pair hash in pairFor.
token1 is a transient ordering local used only for the pair hash in pairFor.
pair is the return local produced by pairFor.
